nodes.summary: The box `Λ_n = [-n, n]^d` as a finset.
nodes.title: Lattice box as a finite set

nodes.summary: The open cluster of `x` in the lattice model is the cluster `MathlibExt.Probability.ProductBondPercolation.gcluster` of bond percolation on the graph `hypercubicLattice d` with the same edge configuration.
nodes.title: Lattice clusters agree with general graph clusters

nodes.summary: The open cluster of `x`: the set of sites connected to `x` by an open path.
nodes.title: Open cluster of a site

nodes.summary: Connection inside `S` implies connection inside any `T ⊇ S`.
nodes.title: Open connection within a set is monotone in the set

nodes.summary: `x` and `y` in `S` are connected by an open path that stays inside `S`.
nodes.title: Connection by an open path within a set

nodes.summary: `x` and `y` are connected by an open path, that is, reachable in `openSubgraph d ω`.
nodes.title: Connection by an open path

nodes.summary: A closed walk in the open subgraph that repeats no edge (an open circuit).
nodes.title: Open circuit in a bond configuration

nodes.summary: The lattice edge `{x, y}` is open in the configuration `ω`: `x` and `y` are nearest neighbours and `ω s(x, y) = true`.
nodes.title: Open lattice edge of a bond configuration

nodes.summary: The open subgraph of `ω` induced on a set `S` of sites.
nodes.title: Open subgraph induced on a set of sites

nodes.summary: The open subgraph of `ω`: the spanning subgraph of `ℤ^d` consisting of the open edges.
nodes.title: Open subgraph of a bond configuration

nodes.summary: The critical probability `p_c(d) = sup {p ∈ [0, 1] : θ_d(p) = 0}` of bond percolation on `ℤ^d`.
nodes.title: Critical probability of bond percolation on the hypercubic lattice

nodes.summary: The percolation event `{0 ↔ ∞}`: the open cluster of the origin is infinite.
nodes.title: Percolation event for the origin

nodes.summary: The set of densities `p ∈ [0, 1]` at which `θ_d(p) = 0`.
nodes.title: Set of densities with no percolation

nodes.summary: The percolation probability `θ_d(p) = ℙ_p(0 ↔ ∞)` of Bernoulli bond percolation on `ℤ^d` with edge density `p`.
nodes.title: Percolation probability of bond percolation

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
